notes: All five rings hold from every azimuth, and the micro level now carries the per-member detail: a cap plate on each pod, a lamp on each foot, a bar on each fascia band and each fin, an inlay on each collar plate.

The beam is axial, rooted at the aperture, and reads cyan; the basin is a real concave dish with the emitter torus lying flat in it. Residual: the beam is a hard-edged cylinder where the reference is a soft column that widens at its base and fades out at the top -- that is the additive/alpha work of the material pass, not geometry.

The plinth rim chamfer is real geometry -- a profile step in the 6-sided lathe, widened this iteration from a 0.045 to a 0.07 radial step -- and now reads as a continuous bright band around the hexagon under the key light, which is what the reference shows.

The ramp is present with four lit treads, and the plinth gravel is now 14 real faceted chips scattered deterministically (seed 20260903) across the front arc at radius 0.56-0.90, which is where the reference shows it. Its own detail entry had called for geometry rather than a texture patch; until this iteration it was a localFeature that could never render.
